title: To Practice Forgiveness Is The True Fast,
summary: Forgiveness is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: To practice forgiveness is the true fast, good conduct and contentment
lifeApplication: Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
